priorities.summary: Kyverno before 1.19.1 fails to properly validate URL-encoded path segments in the Policy apiCall urlPath, allowing namespace tenants to bypass the per-namespace clamp and create arbitrary objects across the cluster. Patch to 1.19.1 or later.

GitLab remediated a critical issue in GitLab CE/EE affecting all versions from 19.2 before 19.2.7, 19.3 before 19.3.3, and 19.4 before 19.4.1, exploitable remotely without authentication. Upgrade to 19.2.7, 19.3.3, or 19.4.1.

Eval injection in the JScript event-script dispatcher in Progressive Robot Ltd's hMailServer versions 6.0.0 through 6.3.3 on Windows lets a remote, unauthenticated attacker execute arbitrary code. Upgrade hMailServer immediately.

model.name: MiniMax M3.1-Flash-Preview
model.summary: MiniMax has launched M3.1-Flash-Preview, a new-generation ultra-fast text model now live on MiniMax Code. Positioned for everyday development scenarios — quick bug fixes and complete feature implementation — with an emphasis on response speed and stability.
